verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a disputes API for retrieving a dispute, uploading or assembling evidence, or submitting a response. The MCP server's documented operations cover only payment statuses, refunds, voids and payment links, not disputes. The only dispute-related items are a 'Disputes testing' page title, a 'Preventing fraudulent disputes' page title, and webhooks that report dispute progress; these are adjacent signals, not the end-to-end API capability the story requires.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
